title: kbmon says why a checkout behind origin/main cannot fast-forward
goal: the sprint panel's data holds fast_forward, {can, why}, for the checkout it reads: can is false when tracked files with local changes are also changed by the commits it is behind, or HEAD holds commits origin/main lacks, and why names the cause with the count of files or commits and up to three paths relative to the clone; kbmon --status sprints says the checkout cannot fast-forward, with why

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();w=os.path.join(t,'wt');ok=False
for n in range(3,60):
    ch=s.run(['git','diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=M','origin/main~%d'%n,'origin/main'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
    if ch:break
s.run(['git','worktree','add','-q','--detach',w,'origin/main~%d'%n],check=True,capture_output=True)
try:
    k=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a,'--root',w],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180).stdout
    clean=json.loads(k('--json','--panel','sprint'))['panels']['sprint']['data'].get('fast_forward') or {}
    open(os.path.join(w,ch[0]),'a').write('\nlocal edit\n')
    d=json.loads(k('--json','--panel','sprint'))['panels']['sprint']['data'];ff=d.get('fast_forward') or {}
    st=k('--status','sprints');print(d.get('behind'),clean,ff,ch)
    ok=clean.get('can') is True and ff.get('can') is False and ch[0] in str(ff.get('why')) and 'cannot fast-forward' in st
finally:
    s.run(['git','worktree','remove','--force',w],capture_output=True);shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
